features: Quad Mics with ENx Technology: ENx-powered quad mics in these earbuds eliminate noise for clear calls regardless of your location. Converse in cafés and on public transport hands-free with your Airdopes.
Powerful 13mm Drivers: Tune into thumping bass-rich boAt Signature Sound from the dual 13 mm drivers. Experience every beat to the fullest!
Up to 40 hours of Playback: Groove uninterrupted with the boAt Airdopes 219 TWS Earbuds. Listen to songs and podcasts while unwinding for up to 40 hours.
BEAST Mode: Immerse in the virtual world with the 45 ms low-latency gaming BEAST mode. Enjoy lag-free gaming while playing solo or with your squad.
ASAP Charge: Charge your buds for 10 minutes and keep binge-watching for 120 minutes. Thanks to ASAP Charge, you can resume your favorite web series and tick it off your watchlist.
IPX4 Water Resistance: No matter where you are, keep enjoying audio content as your Airdopes feature IPX4 resistance to prevent sweat and water splashes from damaging them.
Bluetooth v5.4: Advanced Bluetooth v5.4 in Airdopes 219 makes it easy to just pop in your buds at home or on the go without the hassle of tangled wires.
description: Relax to your playlist tunes with the boAt Airdopes 219 TWS Earbuds. With 40 hours of playtime, these earbuds ensure uninterrupted audio entertainment. So, you can game and stream without frequent charging hassles. In addition, four ENxTM-enabled powerful mics enable you to answer calls on the go without disruptive background noise. Catch up on your watchlist with the bass-heavy boAt Signature Sound from the 13 mm drivers and experience enthralling audio. In case of low battery, ASAPTM Charge the earbuds to get 120 minutes of performance after 10 minutes of charging. As soon as you flip open the case lid, your Airdopes get connected with IWPTM technology. Moreover, you can hustle effortlessly with voice assistant activation using your Airdopes. Make calls, check the local weather updates, etc., with voice commands. Also, the 45 ms low latency of BEASTTM mode eliminates lag for a realistic feel while playing games. Airdopes 219 sports an IPX4-resistant design, ensuring sweat and splashes won't get in the way of your grooving!
